semantics: NameX selects a named expression by its owning indexed table; its display sheet does not replace lexical identity.

In valid local SUPBOOKs, NameX uses the first display endpoint independently of the last; first0xffff becomes no display sheet, first0xfffe inherits scope, and both preserve the original global/local name object.
Global names remain explicitly qualified under a colliding sheet-local name; local indexed definitions retain their actual scope even with a different first display sheet.

Only named-reference display scopes admit these markers. Ordinary Ref3D self0xfffe references, true external namespaces and invalid first-sheet indexes remain explicitly refused. Full NameX payload, missing index and work admission stay enforced.
